cohort: 156 diabetic women and 106 healthy women who gave birth at the Clinic of Endocrinology, Diabetes and Metabolic Diseases and Gynecology and Obstetrics Clinic of the Clinical Center of Vojvodina between 2006 and 2010
finding: Women with diabetes, particularly type 1 diabetes, experienced a higher incidence of perinatal morbidity and cesarean sections compared to healthy controls.
mod_finding: Women with type 1 diabetes had a higher incidence of cesarean section than those without diabetes or with type 2 or gestational diabetes.
